title: STEMularity problem
description: One STEM problem in the STEMularity index, stored as data/problems/<id>.json. Labels and longer explanations for every enum value live in vocabulary.json next to this file.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors can validate the file, normally "../schema/problem.schema.json".

id.description: Stable identifier in lowercase kebab-case. Must match the file name without .json. Never change it once published: URLs and links depend on it.

aliases.description: Other names the problem is known by.

field.description: Broad STEM field, used for filtering. See vocabulary.json#/field.

category.description: Subfield or topic within the field, in plain words (for example "Number theory"). Used for sorting and display.

status.description: Where the problem stands. open = not settled and open-ended; unsolved = precisely stated, no accepted answer yet; solved = answered as posed; resolved = closed without an answer as posed (impossible, independent, ill-posed or superseded). See vocabulary.json#/status.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of the problem and where it stands, written in your own words. Never paste text from papers.

ai_effort.description: Recommended AI reasoning effort for working on the next open checkpoint, from low to max. See vocabulary.json#/ai_effort.

ratings.description: Required when status is open or unsolved, and not allowed otherwise.

work_left.description: How much work is left before the problem is fully solved: 1 = almost there, 10 = barely begun.

significance.description: Real-world significance if fully solved: 1 = mostly curiosity value, 10 = would change everyday life or technology.

progress.description: The progress map: an ordered list of checkpoints from the first step to a full solution. Order is the logical route through the problem, not necessarily chronological.

sources.description: Links to papers, articles, datasets and other sources. Link only: never commit copies of copyrighted papers.

sample.description: true marks made-up sample data used while the project is being built. Real entries leave it out.

updated.description: Date this entry was last reviewed or updated.

date.description: A date as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, for when only the year or month is known.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL with a host name.

contributor.description: Who did the work. List people, groups and AI systems separately when they worked together.

checkpoint.description: One step on the progress map. A not-started checkpoint has no contributors or date; in-progress needs contributors; done, disputed and dead-end need contributors and a date.

id.description: Identifier unique within this problem, in lowercase kebab-case. Keep it stable: it anchors links to the checkpoint.

by.description: Who did (or is doing) this checkpoint.

date.description: When the checkpoint was reached (done), claimed (disputed), abandoned (dead-end) or started (in-progress).

links.description: Links to the work itself: write-ups, code, discussions. Link only.
